critical_concepts.elaboration: C++ is a compiled programming language. The source code is converted into machine code using a compiler before execution.
critical_concepts.visual_prompt: Show a pipeline diagram: [C++ Source Code] → [Compiler] → [Machine Code] → [Program Execution]. Animate arrows flowing through the pipeline.

critical_concepts.elaboration: C++ allows direct memory manipulation through pointers and manual allocation using new and delete.
critical_concepts.visual_prompt: Display a memory grid with blocks representing RAM. Show a pointer arrow referencing a memory cell. Animate allocation when 'new' is used and freeing when 'delete' is used.

critical_concepts.elaboration: C++ supports classes, objects, inheritance, polymorphism, encapsulation, and abstraction.
critical_concepts.visual_prompt: Display a class diagram: Class 'Car' at the top with properties and methods. Below it, show multiple object instances like Car1, Car2 inheriting structure.

interactive_questions.title: Entry Point of a C++ Program
interactive_questions.prompt: Which function is the starting point of every C++ program?
interactive_questions.visual_interactive_prompt: Display a visual program flow diagram showing execution starting from a highlighted 'main()' block and flowing through the program.
interactive_questions.explanation: Every C++ program begins execution from the main() function.

interactive_questions.title: Output Statement
interactive_questions.prompt: Which C++ statement is used to print text to the console?
interactive_questions.visual_interactive_prompt: Show a console window visualization. Animate text appearing when the cout statement executes.
interactive_questions.explanation: cout (from iostream) is used with the << operator to display output.

interactive_questions.title: Standard Input Output Library
interactive_questions.prompt: Which header file is required for using cout and cin?
interactive_questions.visual_interactive_prompt: Show a program file including libraries. Highlight the #include <iostream> line and visually link it to input/output operations.
interactive_questions.explanation: The iostream header provides the input/output stream objects like cin and cout.

interactive_questions.title: Integer Variable
interactive_questions.prompt: Which keyword is used to declare an integer variable in C++?
interactive_questions.visual_interactive_prompt: Show a variable container labeled 'int'. When a value is assigned, the container fills with the number.
interactive_questions.explanation: The keyword int is used to declare integer variables.

interactive_questions.title: Single Line Comment
interactive_questions.prompt: Which symbol is used to write a single-line comment in C++?
interactive_questions.visual_interactive_prompt: Display a code editor where lines starting with // are grayed out to indicate they are ignored by the compiler.
interactive_questions.explanation: Double forward slashes // are used for single-line comments.

interactive_questions.title: Arrange the C++ Program Structure
interactive_questions.prompt: Drag the following parts to create a valid C++ program structure.
interactive_questions.visual_interactive_prompt: Display draggable code blocks scattered on the screen. Students drag them into a vertical code editor layout to build a working C++ program.
interactive_questions.explanation: A valid C++ program starts with headers, followed by namespace declaration, main function, program body, and return statement.

interactive_questions.title: Match Variable Type with Example
interactive_questions.prompt: Drag each example to the correct variable type.
interactive_questions.visual_interactive_prompt: Show two columns: variable types on the left and example declarations on the right. Students drag examples to match the correct type container.
interactive_questions.explanation: Each variable type stores different forms of data in C++.

interactive_questions.title: Match Operator with Function
interactive_questions.prompt: Drag each operator to its correct meaning.
interactive_questions.visual_interactive_prompt: Show operator symbols as draggable cards and math operation labels as drop targets. Animate the operation result when a correct match is made.
interactive_questions.explanation: Arithmetic operators perform mathematical calculations in C++.
